## 📝 Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
Please include a concise summary of the changes and the related issue/feature motivation.

Closes #(issue number)

---

### Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX styling or animation update
- [ ] 🎮 3D mini-game or algorithm visualization addition
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update or correction
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization or query refactor
- [ ] 🧪 Test suite addition or enhancement

---

### Verification & Testing Conducted
Please describe the tests and checks you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] **TypeScript Check:** `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` passed with 0 errors.
- [ ] **Frontend Build Check:** `npm run build` succeeded without build failures.
- [ ] **Django Check:** `python manage.py check` passed with zero issues.
- [ ] **Manual Testing:** Tested flow in browser (describe steps taken and routes visited).

---

### Screenshots / Screen Recordings (if applicable)
Please attach before/after screenshots or recordings demonstrating the visual/interactive changes.

---

### Contributor Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines in [`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`](./docs/DEVELOPMENT.md).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `docs/` where applicable.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors.
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, or secrets have been committed.
